paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Ablation studies between Consistency-Bi and Consistency-Uni on test set of IWSLT14 De-En task of wait-k policy.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL), comparing three methods labeled Consistency-CE, Consistency-Uni, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and uses a linear scale spanning approximately 1 to 9, with visible tick labels at 2-unit intervals (2, 4, 6, 8). The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale ranging from about 19 to 33, with horizontal gridlines and tick labels appearing every 2 BLEU points (20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 30, 32). The Consistency-CE series is drawn as a purple dashed line with circular markers, increasing across the x-axis from about 19.2 at AL≈1 to about 31.3 at AL≈9, passing through roughly 26.1 (AL≈3), 28.7 (AL≈5), and 30.4 (AL≈7). The Consistency-Uni series is drawn as a green solid line with square markers, increasing from about 25.3 at AL≈2 to about 32.6 at AL≈9, with intermediate values around 28.1 (AL≈4), 30.1 (AL≈5), and 31.8 (AL≈7). The Consistency-Bi series is drawn as a red solid line with star markers, rising from about 25.9 at AL≈1 to about 32.5 at AL≈9, with intermediate points near 28.4 (AL≈3), 30.6 (AL≈5), and 31.8 (AL≈7).
